target_scope.description: Working past-18-years window for architecture-related administrative and documented milestones. Records are evidence of the stated source milestone only, not evidence of construction outcomes unless the source explicitly states completion or opening.

sources.publisher: Belfast City Council, Belfast Harbour, Translink, Department of Education, Ulster University and other official project owners

rejection_rules: Reject records with no licence or unresolved terms for public redistribution unless only minimal factual metadata and source URLs are retained with a clear rights caveat.
Reject records with no usable source date or only a retrieval date.
Reject records with no geometry, geometry reference or affected-area label.
Reject records that require ingesting private personal data, planning representations, signatures, private contact details or applicant documents without review.
Reject records whose summary implies causality, speculative future modelling, construction outcome, completion or opening beyond the source wording.
dedupe_rules: Exact source row id and source id first.
Then compare address/site name, effective date, event type and geometry or affected area.
Merge evidence references when records describe the same administrative milestone; do not delete raw rows.
Keep separate events for distinct lifecycle milestones from the same project, such as application, decision, permit issued, commencement, completion and opening.
